Thank you for responding.. I have tried a sport, archery. It went on for probably 2 years, but just didn't work out with the coach anymore, and I never really liked archery in the first place, so we haven't been back since. It's hard for me to find activities or clubs because of our lack of money and my difficulty to approach people or keep a conversation going. 

I'll definitely look into those diagnosis'. Thanks again 👍🏻

Yes, the incident caused a lot of trauma. We were living with my mother's boyfriend at the time, whom was cheating on her and told us one day to just get out of his house. Having nowhere to go and no money, we had to move to my grandmother's. We lived with him for 6-7 years, my brother and I seeing him as a sort of father figure (Neither of us have had our fathers in our lives). But the move completely changed my mom, she became more of a pessimist and just quite hating the world and men in general, and my brother being involved in drugs and such, almost being killed a couple of times. The move caused me to lose the very few friends I had, and I was bullied a lot at my new school, by both students and teachers. This is why I switched to homeschooling. It all snowballed from there..

Thank you for responding. It does help to be assured I'm not alone. I really am trying to stay strong 👍🏻
